engineering.summary: Xyce produced fresh, structurally valid tran simulation evidence.

diagnostics.message: The analysis completed, so a quantity may be reported as measured - but only once a typed measurement envelope carries it. A number parsed out of the raw file by hand is not one: nothing in the result contract binds it to this run. This envelope has been retained at /evidence/sim/xyce-tran/simulate.result.json. The retained raw declares 'time' as the axis - which must NOT appear in selectors - over the vectors V(1). Continue with: openada extract --simulation /evidence/sim/xyce-tran/simulate.result.json --artifact /evidence/sim/xyce-tran/xyce-tran/xyce-tran.xyce.raw --selection /evidence/sim/xyce-tran/simulate.selection.json, then `openada measure` on the series it returns; its kinds are sample_at, minimum, maximum, mean, rms, crossing, rise_time, fall_time and settling_time, each reading ONE named signal. A ratio of two signals is not among them - for a gain, a differential gain or a driving-point impedance, run an AC analysis and use `openada transfer`. `openada spectral` covers snr, sinad, thd and sfdr on a coherent single tone.

provenance_limitations: Only the declared top-level model-free analysis deck and selected native executable were content-bound; host runtime libraries and simulator defaults remain bounded provenance.
